description: Lists channel groups (named sets of accounts) with their member account ids. Use this when the user names a group ("post to my brand accounts") to resolve it to the account ids schedule_post takes. Returns groups[] (id, name, accountIds, accountCount), nextCursor and hasMore. Does NOT create or edit groups.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

name: list_groups

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when there is none.

title: List channel groups
